name: command-setup-group-expansion
reason: The fixture adapter used grouped selection to enable a single prescribed native analysis object. It now selects those object IDs directly.

name: ui-setup-group-expansion
reason: Same grouped-selection fixture adapter, observed by the windowless UI replay.

name: command-continuity-initial-state
reason: A preceding preview control change persisted Native G1. Replays now initialize from the public initial getter state; command preferences distinguish preselection options from preview controls.

name: ui-legacy-default-reset
reason: An older test expected all continuities to reset. Native preview-control captures prove the G1 choice survives cancellation; the expectation is now G1/G2.

name: clippy-shared-test-module
reason: The new UI test loaded an existing shared helper a second time. It now imports the already-loaded module.

name: clippy-reused-helper-imports
reason: Reusing the shared helper made two local imports unnecessary; they were removed.

name: python-run-terminated
reason: The check process received SIGTERM after reaching Python. Read-only process inspection confirmed that the checker and unittest child were absent. Fifteen successful checks were retained; only unfinished work was resumed.
